summary: Validate the evaluation annotator against the owner's blind judgement (15 items) and correct experiment 2. Binary useful>=2 agreement is 15/15, but exact agreement is only 40% because the annotator never emits 0 and shifts 0->1 / 2->3. Under the validated binary rule all three systems in experiment 2 score P@5=1.00, so the earlier discrimination claim is withdrawn and E-RANKING stays not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit c763d8c. Agreement tooling + tests + registries/docs; no new network calls.

budget_impact.rationale: No runtime or model call; only parsing a locally filled sheet and comparing cached labels. Runtime operations/ceilings unchanged.
budget_impact.before: Annotator labels unvalidated; experiment 2 appeared to discriminate recency from profile ranking at the >=3 threshold.
budget_impact.after: Binary agreement validated 15/15; graded scale shown miscalibrated; discrimination claim withdrawn; second blind sheet prepared to resolve annotator level 2.
